entities.summary: Alma Maria Katarina Sundquist (1872–1940) was a Swedish physician and a pioneering female specialist in the treatment of venereal diseases. A committed women's rights activist, she campaigned for better working conditions for women, addressed problems associated with unhygienic homes and prostitution, and promoted the need for sexual education for girls. She fought for women's suffrage, contributing to the inaugural meeting of the Swedish Association for Women's Suffrage (FKPR) in June 1902. Alma Sundquist was a physicians & medical pioneers from Torps församling, Härnösand diocese (1872-03-23, Torps församling, Härnösand diocese–1940-01-07). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
